comment: Eighteen parameters (indices 0 to 17) are an older set of equaliser controls kept for patch compatibility; they have no widget on the panel, so no click can reach them and they get no line. The equaliser is the same design as the Imp module: a 250Hz low shelf and a 2000Hz high shelf at Butterworth Q, and a 700Hz peak at a Q of 0.8 (Mixer6.cpp:80 to :84). Pan is equal power, cosine to the left output and sine to the right over a quarter turn (Mixer6.cpp:231, :232, :287, :288). The mute button decrements a state that wraps from -1 back to 1, so one press mutes, the next solos and the third returns to normal (Mixer6.cpp:369 to :374). Parameters other than the main section are re-read only every 32 samples (Mixer6.cpp:201), so a fast automation of a fader is not followed sample by sample. The meters are refreshed every 512 samples.
